🔍 CNN Learning Lab

Discover how a computer learns to read handwritten digits — by building, testing, and training a real convolutional neural network yourself.

  • Takes about 20–30 minutes for the Guided Mission. Explore longer in the Playground.
  • Training is simulated using recorded and educational results — it does not retrain a model in your browser.
  • Digit prediction uses a real, previously-trained neural network running entirely on your device.
  • Nothing you draw or do here ever leaves your browser.
